2026_01_TB_CIN.paragraph1: Tampa Bay enters Cincinnati with Jalen McMillan, Sean Tucker and Justin Skule doubtful, while the Bengals have Joe Burrow healthy and Ja’Marr Chase available despite a late rest-related practice absence. The Buccaneers still have enough skill talent to challenge Cincinnati, but protection and receiver availability make sustained drives more difficult. Cincinnati’s revamped defense must avoid giving up explosives, while Tampa Bay needs its pass rush and coverage to keep Burrow from repeatedly attacking favorable matchups outside the numbers.

Its frozen F-ST engine reconciles a 64.3% football-only signal with a 64.5% vig-free market signal under the 2026 production specification; it is not a fixed arithmetic blend. That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Cincinnati Bengals -4.2, a market line of Cincinnati Bengals -3.5, and an approximate coherent score of CIN 25 – TB 21. Cincinnati can stress Tampa Bay’s thinner offensive personnel by forcing a higher-scoring pace, while the Buccaneers need pressure and explosive-play prevention to keep Burrow uncomfortable. The pick: Cincinnati Bengals moneyline.

2026_01_WAS_PHI.headline: Washington’s restored pass rush gets a direct test against Philadelphia’s balanced offense
2026_01_WAS_PHI.paragraph1: Washington expects Odafe Oweh, K’Lavon Chaisson and Jacory Croskey-Merritt to play, restoring important pieces for an opener that demands pressure without sacrificing gap discipline against Saquon Barkley. Philadelphia will be without Jonathan Greenard, but its offense still forces defenses to account for Jalen Hurts as both passer and runner. The Commanders need their front to disrupt without losing contain, while the Eagles can control the game by staying efficient on early downs and creating favorable play-action opportunities behind the run threat.

Its frozen F-ST engine reconciles a 66.8% football-only signal with a 68.5% vig-free market signal under the 2026 production specification; it is not a fixed arithmetic blend. That official probability translates to a probability-implied presentation line of Philadelphia Eagles -5.8, a market line of Philadelphia Eagles -6.0, and an approximate coherent score of PHI 27 – WAS 21. Washington’s healthier edge group gives it a credible pressure plan, but Philadelphia’s run-pass balance can punish overaggressive fronts and create favorable coverage conflicts throughout the game. The pick: Philadelphia Eagles moneyline.
